title: Guiding Neuro-Symbolic Scenario Generation with Spatio-Temporal Logic

control_signal.value: A Colored STREL formula (spatio-temporal logic over agent types) specifying the target behaviour, e.g. fast vehicle reaching a pedestrian or bike, fast vehicle behind slow vehicle, plus realism formulae.

control_mechanism.value: At inference, gradient ascent over the diffusion model's latent z to maximize differentiable STREL robustness, with a latent-prior likelihood penalty (lambda) to stay on the data manifold; deterministic implicit sampling enables backprop.

base_model.value: Latent diffusion model for joint multi-agent trajectories with Optimal Gaussian Diffusion, context from pre-trained QCNet injected via cross-attention; implicit sampling with 100 denoising steps.

datasets.value: Argoverse 2 Motion Forecasting dataset, official train and validation splits; three validation scenarios used for evaluation.

metrics.value: Distribution of minimum inter-agent distance D; count of potential collisions (agent within 0.9 m); share of scenarios with positive STREL robustness; qualitative plausibility.

controllability_evidence.value: Scenarios with positive robustness rise from about 13,6% unguided to 100% with guidance. Potential collisions out of 30: front property 5 (17%) to 19 (63%); pb_uns 0 to 5 (17%); surr 0 to 7 (23%).

stated_limitations.value: Formulae must be designed manually; future work aims to infer safety-critical specifications from road geometry and agents, and to adversarially optimize latents against a driving policy.

notes: Small evaluation (3 scenarios). Percentage text says 13,6% unguided as in packet; the table counts differ from that figure.
